text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To the both of you. Thank you very much 
for coordinating the birthday party plans 
so smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"No, not at all. I was simply acting on 
Fine-senpai's advice."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're exaggerating! All I advised 
was that it'd be safer to pencil in three 
candidates just in case.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's almost entirely thanks to 
Messiah-chan staring down the schedule and 
making it work!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Well then, let's call it even. 
But really, I'm just glad we could come to 
an agreement.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted you to have a fun and 
wonderful birthday, Ruby-senpai, so...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I am truly grateful for all your 
consideration. This favor—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ruby! While staying true to yourself 
is fine, why not relax your shoulders just 
a little bit today?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just convey what you feel, exactly as you 
feel it... This isn't a formal social 
gathering or anything, right? We're just 
friends! Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Messiah-san. Thank you so much for 
doing this for me."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... hehehe, yes! Hearing you say that 
makes me happier than anything!
